title: What the Pits Held
description: The king went down to the mine pits in the first assault. I have said 'unaccounted for' ever since, and the hold says it after me. Walk the pit galleries and come back up able to say the other word.

objectives.description: Cross Kazan's Span to the mine workings
Find what was dragged out of the pit floor
Ask the Loremaster what the rites require
Tell Regent Morgrim what you found

notes: Bible: the dwarf king is found dead at the bottom of the mine pits. The body is NOT recovered here - it is already in goblin hands by the time the player reaches it. Ids stay name-agnostic (dwarf_regent, not morgrim) so a rename is text-only.
